bestBets.overview: Solid Provincial Maiden to kick off proceedings here at Hawkesbury. It looks a race in two on paper. I'm keen to lean the way of the Kristen Buchanan-trained READY MADE HEIR, third preparation where race experience is no issue. She has figures on the board to win this already and did look sharp in a sole Hawkesbury trial. SPICE TRAIL started $2.20 on debut when quickly folding up at the 200m mark. Returns to the races off a 135-day break and has looked solid enough in two trials. OUR NOBLE BOY is the market watch. One very soft trial leading in, poor gate yes, but has ability. The locally trained CINCERITAS is next best.

raceTips.comment: Spice Trail was well supported on debut last prep and seemingly didn't fire. Given time, recent trials have been promising and the addition of a tongue tie is an important gear change of note. Ready Made Heir was the model of minor money consistency last prep and has trialled well. Frosty Bangers found the line well in a recent trial and has shown ability in the past. Silverwater Kid was posted wide last time so be somewhat forgiving of the beaten margin. Gear changes have been made.

bestBets.overview: Extremely strong $60k 3YO Super Maiden. Bjorn Baker has sent an army to the race, the pick of his has to be the 3YO gelding FLIGHT OF POWER. Second career prep and boy, he has lit up the trials with back-to-back impressive wins. He maps ideally here on debut and draws impressively. CZECH ME comes off one of the best Canberra Acton trials you'll see, fast overall time when only allowed to hit second gear. The gate is the worry but has speed. HOPE TO FLY has been gelded into this prep. One spin around Gosford has him prepped up for this. ARTEMEX looks likely to improve here 2nd up.

raceTips.comment: Flight Of Power impressed in his recent trial win when ridden coldly to finish off. His debut was the opposite to that and he tired late. Given time and the addition of a tongue tie should see him in for a fruitful preparation. Czech Me was hard to miss at the trials when winning a heat by 12L. Has been absolutely smashed in betting the minute prices went live. Mille Feuille has excuses when resuming and wasn't beaten far in what looked to be a handy enough maiden. De Grawin Queen has won both trials leading in so a forward showing on debut is expected.

HARRYBEGOOD was better than good fresh, dominant win when ridden on speed over the 1100m. Straight to 1300m now, finds a similar-class event and gets an in-form Will Stanley in the saddle. The Greg Hickman-trained SUPERATA has trialled up exceptionally well. He looks very well placed here fresh. Smart gate and is a proper danger to the favourite. I like the way the Chris Waller-trained GAULTIER is progressing. Smart Goulburn win and can only bounce off that confidence-wise now. SCHUMACHER is next best after being heavily backed on debut.

raceTips.comment: Harrybegood impressed when resuming drawing clear through the line. He has been very well supported as soon as prices went up and expect him to justify that. Schumacher hit the line well when winning as favourite on debut and has upside. As does Gaultier who now sports blinkers and should be peaking third up. Superata looks an each-way chance.

bestBets.overview: Intriguing 1400m Maiden. I?m always happy to forgive a horse off one bad run. SATIN SERENADE is that horse. She trialled up like a star before looking extremely flat on debut. She was beaten by the smart Queen?s Gamble though ? that form looks sharp. Up to 1400m and drops in class. Her race to lose. LADY CAPITALIST was too bad to be true first-up. Look for a much-improved second-up effort out in trip. SO FORTUNATE and BOSTON GLIDE both come here for their debut with a number of trials under the belt. Expect they can put in strong debut efforts.

raceTips.comment: Satin Serenade has been favourite in both runs to date and found one better on each occasion, the latter of whom has since won impressively in stronger grade franking the form. She is short enough in betting, but strikes a very nice race to get her maiden out of the way. Beautiful You was only nailed late after leading throughout on debut and will have derived good benefit from the run. Made In Italy can improve up in trip with a race day fitness base. Sourseane should appreciate the rise in distance after a pass mark debut run.

bestBets.overview: We round out the day with an intriguing Maiden contest over the 1400m. The Chris Waller-trained UNBRIDLED STORM goes on top, comes through a strong Kembla Grange contest when finding the line well. Gets a key jockey upgrade with Bullock taking the ride and looks very well placed staying at 1400m. The stablemate and first starter CRIMSONOR is the danger. Wasn?t asked for an effort in either trial but I liked his action and his work through the line. I expect TEMPESTUOUS to improve sharply here second-up. Sticky gate but a long run to the first turn. STATEROOM was plain second-up after a smart debut effort, back in grade and can improve. DALLAS DUKE is next best but needs to improve.

raceTips.comment: Tempestuous comes via a maiden that has already produced subsequent winning form and we get a further gauge of that form when Harrybegood goes around earlier on in the card. The rise in distance looks ideal. Unbridled Storm had no market expectation when resuming over this trip but was very good. Will have fans as the market suggests. Wendell and Stateroom come via the same last time out that had some depth to it. Both have upside and look well placed here.
